source_en: You're new, or I'm late. Petre Dolidze. Small parish above the north ridge.
I write poems. They go nowhere. I consider that a feature.
God. Mountains. The dog. Order depends on the week.
Two volumes. One printed, one lent out and never returned.
A grey dog walks the ridge with me. My wife found it too quiet.
The quiet doesn't bother me. I think that was the problem.
I needed something with more than two walls.
Papers. The dog has none, but I vouch for him.
